Commentary.Commentary: It's over to the Bangladesh batsmen. The pitch is a testing one. It has got a plenty of spin in it and the hosts will have to bat smartly. They will be up against the spin trio of Rashid, Moeen and Batty, who will be licking their lips on the prospect of bowling on this turner. Promises to be an entertaining battle. Stay tuned for Bangladesh's reply...

England won't be too disappointed with their batting performance. The final outcome given the way they started isn't too bad. The lower middle order played a big role in that. Moeen Ali, Jonny Bairstow were involved in a crucial stand while the likes of Chris Woakes and Adil Rashid played handy knocks.

Debutant Mehedi Hasan was an absolute super star for the hosts as he bagged a 6-wicket haul and impressed one and all with his accurate bowling. Taijul Islam was in his elements this morning and grabbed a couple as well.

Right then, England managed to add 35 runs to their overnight total and got bundled out seven short of the 300-run mark. Still, it's look like a very competitive first innings total, given the way the pitch is behaving.

OUT! Broad is gone! Mehedi bowls a nicely tossed up off spinner around off, drifting in and spinning away, Stuart gets forward in defense, feels for it and pushes inside the line. He fails to middle it and the ball whizzes past the outside edge. Rahim collects the ball and jumps in appeal but nothing from the umpire. He quickly goes for the DRS and the Ultra Edge detects a little spike. Mehedi finishes with a 6-fer and ENGLAND ARE ALL OUT FOR 293!
Appeal for a catch as Rahim collects the ball behind the stumps. The umpire remains unmoved and the Bangladesh skipper is quick to take the DRS.
Loopy full ball on off, Broad lunges and defends it close to his front pad.
Tickles a full ball to deep backward square leg and gets off the mark with a single.
Slower loopy ball on middle and leg, Batty tries to flick but misses. It goes off his pads to short leg and the crowd gets excited.
Quicker full ball on middle, forced on the leg side but straight to short mid-wicket.
Leans forward and plays it with the spin on the leg side. A maiden!
Goes down on one knee and sweeps it straight to short leg. It deflects off the fielder's body to short fine leg.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Quicker full ball on middle, Broad is hurried up a bit as he defends it from the crease.
Flatter on off, spinning in, Broad goes back and punches it to mid off.
Gets forward to a full ball and defends it down watchfully.
Batty has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Quicker one around leg, Batty goes back to hit it on the leg side but misses. The ball wasn't too far away from the leg pole.
Stifled appeal for an lbw again as Batty fails to defend it off his front foot. This time it seems the impact is slightly outside off. Turned down!
Flatter on middle, defended off the pads to the leg side.
Shout for an lbw! An off spinner landing around middle and turning in a bit, Batty fails to defend it and is hit on the pads. They put in an unsuccessful appeal. The replays show it's too high!
Flighted ball on off, too full in length, Broad digs it out towards mid-wicket and scampers across for a single.
Another watchful forward defensive shot by Gareth to end the over.
Strides forward and defends it gently with the spin to the off side.
Lovely delivery, tossed up around off, Batty gets forward to defend but it spins away to beat the outside edge.
Gets down on one knee, fetches a full ball from around off and sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter and quicker on off, spinning down, Broad tries to whip on the leg side but misses. Rahim does well to collect it.

APPEAL FOR AN LBW! Taijul switches to over the wicket for the left-hander and bowls a flighted full ball just outside off. It spins back in to strike Broad on the pads as he fails to defend. They appeal and umpire Dharmasena raises his finger. Broad quickly reviews it and the replays find it to be missing leg. Turning too much.
Flighted and outside off, defended off the front foot.
Loopy full ball on off, spinning in, Batty draws forward in defense and keeps it out off the inside edge.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up ball on middle, spinning down, Batty goes back to work it on the leg side but misses. He is hit on the pads, Rahim appeals but nothing from the umpire. Missing leg easily.
Tossed up ball on off, fuller in length, Gareth gets forward and defends.
Too full in length on off, Broad squeezes it out through covers and crosses for a single.
Probably an arm ball around off, Batty is forced on the back foot in defense.
Batty has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Strides forward to a full ball and defends it down.
Gareth Batty is the new batsman. He is playing a Test match after a span of 11 long years.

OUT! Sharp catch by debutant Sabbir! Taijul goes flat through the air and lands it shorter around off, Rashid goes back to punch it through the line but fails to keep it down. Sabbir manning the short extra cover region dives to his left to take a cracking catch inches off the surface. End of a vital contribution from Rashid. Second wicket for Taijul this morning.

FOUR! It's more like a helicopter shot! Flighted full ball on middle, Rashid brings his bottom hand into play and swings it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Not much followthrough of the bat but it came off the meaty part!
Flighted and on off, Rashid gets forward and defends it.
Flatter and shorter on off, Broad is on the back foot in defense. 100 overs done and dusted!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Pushes it quicker through the air, bowled with a round-arm action, it's around off and Broad defends it off his front foot.
Tossed up ball on middle, Broad takes his bat in front of the pad in defense.
Lunges to a full ball and blocks it on the off side.
Fuller in length on off, Broad defends it off the inside half of the bat.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Another fine shot! Taijul is on the shorter side with his length, around middle, Rashid picks it early and flick-pulls it powerfully through mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Lovely stroke! Flighted full ball on off, Rashid reaches out for it and lofts it cleanly over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Gets down on one knee and sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Spinning down, Broad fails to keep it away and is hit on the pads. They appeal for an lbw but to no avail. Missing leg.
Spin and bounce from around middle and leg, Rashid gets back and taps it down to short leg.
Spinning down the leg side, Rashid eases it wide of backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Takes a strides in to a full ball and defends it solidly.
Tossed up ball on middle, helped off the pads to the leg side but straight to square leg.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Gets forward and defends it with the spin to the leg side.
Two fielders at short mid-wicket now. Rashid played a couple of wristy shots in the last over of Hasan. Maybe, they are working on the plan to make him play those shots and wait for a mishit.
Loopy and outside off, Rashid pushes it gently in the gap at covers for a quick single. Good smart batting!
Throws it up slower through the air and drops it on a fuller length around off, Rashid defends it by getting forward.
Flatter on middle, a touch short too, Broad goes back to work it around the corner for a single at square leg.
Tossed up and around middle and leg, Broad defends it on the leg side.
Wristy on this occasion. Rashid gets forward and flicks it with the spin through backward square leg for a single.
Floated full ball on middle, Rashid goes hard at it and gets it off the inner half of the bat. It speeds through mid-wicket and they collect a brace.
Too full on this occasion, Broad jams it out.
Lovely delivery, landing around off and curving away, Broad goes back to defend but it spins away to beat his bat.
Short and wide outside off, Broad punches it without much timing to short extra cover.
Strides forward to a full ball and defends it to the off side.
A deep backward square leg comes into place now.

FOUR! Another fine horizontal bat shot by Broad. Flighted ball on middle, spinning away a bit, Broad goes down on one knee and sweeps it firmly through backward square leg for a boundary. Vital runs these.
Flighted and on off, Broad presses forward in defense.
Flatter on middle, defended on the leg side to end a good over by Taijul!
Gets well forward to a full ball and defends it safely.
Peach of a delivery! Drifting into the batsman and landing around middle, Rashid lunges to play the line but it spins away sharply to beat the outside edge.
Slower through the air this time and around off, Rashid goes back and punches it to covers, not in the gap though.
Flatter through the air and around middle and off, Rashid goes on the back foot in defense.
Tossed up ball on off, very full in length, Rashid forces it out to mid off.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Tossed up ball around off, Broad gets forward and across to lap sweep it down towards fine leg for a boundary. Nicely played by Stuart!
Switches to around the wicket for the left-hander and bowls a full flighted off spinner on off, Broad gets forward in defense.
Flatter and fuller on middle, turned through mid-wicket for a single.

DECISION OVERTURNED! Hasan serves an off spinner around middle and leg, turning down a bit, Rashid decides to offer no shot and takes it on his pads. They appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Adil goes for the review and the replays show that it's missing leg comfortably.
Adil Rashid is given out lbw. He reviews it.
England are away on day 2! Tossed up ball wide outside off, it's driven through covers for a couple of runs.
Debutant Mehedi Hasan to operate from the other end.
Quicker ball on middle, Broad is pushed back in defense. Excellent first over by Taijul, a wicket maiden!
Tossed up ball on middle and off, it's defended off the front foot to the off side.
Flatter and quicker outside off, skidding away, Broad goes back, pushes inside the line and misses.
Loopy full ball on off, spinning in, Broad lunges and defends.
Great delivery, once again an arm ball outside off, Broad plays for the spin and gets beaten.
Stuart Broad is in next.

OUT! What a start! A wicket first ball for Bangladesh. Islam dishes out an arm ball around middle and leg, it skids on after pitching as Woakes gets forward to defend. But the ball takes the inner half of the bat, brushes his pads and pops out to short leg where Mominul holds on to a good catch. Early success for the Bangla Tigers and they are delighted.
It's time to get going. The players are making their way out in the centre. Chris Woakes and Adil Rashid are the overnight English batsmen. Taijul Islam to begin proceedings. Here we go...

Mehedi Hasan had a dream debut, claiming a fifer and he would be aiming to add more to his tally this morning. The other bowlers would also like to step up as they were hot and cold yesterday. The visiting team will be eyeing to touch the 300-run mark and add as many as possible to their overnight total. Another riveting contest between bat and ball awaits us. Stay tuned for all the action...

Hello and welcome ladies and gentlemen. We witnessed an enthralling day of Test cricket yesterday where both teams had their moments. It was a fair battle between bat and ball and eventually, it's England who have their noses just in front after putting up a total which can be termed competitive on this turning pitch.
DAY 2, SESSION 1...

Hope you enjoyed the day's coverage. With the way the surface is playing, tomorrow should be another action-packed day for sure. England will want to cross the psychological 300-run barrier to put pressure totally on the hosts. Bangladesh will hope to wrap up the innings as quickly as possible. Do join us at 0930 IST for the second day's play. Until then, it's goodbye from us. Cheers!

Barring Mehedi, the other Bangladeshi spinners were good only in patches with even the likes of Shakib failing to find his length consistently. The pacers had little work to do with Kamrul disappointing big time. The track has helped the spinners but once the ball got soft, it's been difficult for the edges to carry due to the slow turn. England's total is already looking competitive. The over rate from Bangladesh was incredibly brisk today with extra overs being bowled.

Ali, after having had several close calls going his way, departed to a peach from debutant Mehedi who also removed Bairstow with the second new ball. He finished with a 5-fer on debut and was easily the pick of the Bangladeshi bowlers by some distance. Woakes and  Rashid hung around till stumps to prevent further damage with the former looking quite solid out there in the middle, thereby taking the total past the 250-run mark.

Ends a see-saw day of Test match cricket with England marginally being the happier side. The tourists didn't start well after opting to bat as they lost quick wickets up front but Root and Ali hung in for a while to stem the rot. The English vice-captain appeared fluent but his wicket along with that of Stokes saw Bangladesh once again seizing the initiative.  Ali continued to prosper and found an able partner in Bairstow with both batsmen getting to their fifties.
Good delivery, full and around off, Rashid watches the line closely and then shoulders arms. THAT WILL BE STUMPS ON DAY 1!
Straighter in line, Woakes turns inside the crease and eases it through mid-wicket for a single. Final ball of the day coming up...
Fullish and on off, Woakes presents a dead straight bat in defense.

Digs in a short ball on off, Adil nicely gets on top of the bounce and plays a well-controlled pull shot all along the ground to deep square leg. Good stop in the deep by Mominul to save a run for his team.
Pitches it full and closer to the off stump line, Rashid gets forward to cover the line and shoulders arms. This wasn't much far away from the off pole.
Slips a length ball down the leg side, Rashid has an easy leave.

Dead ball! Flighted ball spinning down the leg side, Woakes offers no shot and the keeper fails to collect it. The ball runs down to the boundary at fine leg. Nothing added to the total as the batsman was not offering any shot. We still have a couple of minutes left for stumps, so one more over can be accommodated.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Full flighted outside off, defended off the front foot by Woakes.
Spinning down, Rashid goes back to flick but misses and it goes off his pads past leg gully. A leg bye taken.
Flighted around middle and leg, spinning down, Rashid allows it through to the keeper.
Tossed up ball on middle, flicked off the pads to short mid-wicket.
Just enough time to slip in another over. Here comes the 91st over of the day and debutant Mehedi Hasan to bowl it...
Back of a length delivery on off, Woakes punches it off his back foot to covers.
Drops it on a length and outside off, an easy leave by Woakes.
Wide! A wild delivery, way outside off, bowled with a slinging action, Chris leaves it.
FOUR! Lovely timing and placement. Rabbi pitches it full and outside off, Woakes gets on the front foot and drives it elegantly through covers for a boundary.
On a length and outside off, a hint of away shape, Woakes tries to hit through the cover region but misses.
Wide delivery, too much outside off, an easy leave for Woakes.
Good length ball on off, Rashid goes on the back foot and punches it towards backward point. The fielder stationed there dives and makes a partial stop. A single taken in the meantime.
Kamrul Islam Rabbi is back to bowl the 90th over. The over rate has been so good that Bangladesh can even slip in a couple more before the stipulated stumps' time.
Eases himself on the front leg and defends it close to his front bat. Good blocking by Woakes!
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Flighted and outside off, pushed off the front foot and with the spin to covers.
Floated full ball on middle, Chris gets forward and defends it solidly.
Woakes has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Gets back to a shortish ball and punches it to mid off.
A bit on the shorter side this time, Woakes gets back inside the crease and eases it with the spin through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on middle, a straight batted defense offered by Woakes.
Spinning back in with extra bounce, Woakes takes his bottom hand off the handle in defense.
Lunges to a full ball and whips it through mid-wicket for a run.
Gets on the front foot and defends it to short leg.
Flatter and around off, spinning in, Woakes gets back and hits it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up ball outside off, Rashid leaves it alone and Rahim does well to collect it.
Rashid has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Goes slower through the air but bowls it short as well, Rashid initially looks to defend but after watching the line, he tries to punch. But he is a bit late and as a result there isn't much power and timing behind the shot.
Full floated ball on off, defended with a lunge by Rashid.
Tossed up ball outside off, left alone by Adil.
Loopy ball drifting into the batsman, it's full and on middle, Rashid draws forward in defense.
Gets forward to a full ball and offers a straight bat in defense.

Poor delivery, wrong line, quicker one down the leg side, the batsman and keeper fail to do their job and Sabbir chases it from leg gully. He does well to pull it back just before the rope and the batsmen pick up three byes.
Tossed up ball on off, bunted down with the spin to mid on for a quick single.
Leans forward to a full ball and pushes it to the off side.
Flatter and outside off, not spinning much, Woakes goes back to defend but is beaten as it skids past the outside edge.
Full floated ball outside off, Woakes lunges and defends it to the off side.
Loopy full ball on middle, Adil draws forward and defends it back with a straight bat.
Rashid has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Darts a full ball down the leg side, Rashid tries flicking but misses.
Shortish on off, punched to sweeper cover for a single.
Slower in pace and outside off, Woakes defends it from the crease to the off side.
Flatter and a touch shorter on off, Woakes goes back and punches it to covers.
Shakib Al Hasan is back on.
Lunges to a full ball and defends it to the off side.

NOT OUT! Tossed up  ball on middle, an off spinner, Rashid decides to offer no shot and is hit on the front pad. They appeal, the umpire disagrees and Rahim quickly takes the DRS. The replays show that it's easily missing leg. Point to note is that since he was leaving the ball, impact wasn't necessary.
Huge shout for an lbw! Not given and Rahim immediately takes the review.
Beautifully bowled, skidding through after landing outside off, Rashid plays for the spin and gets beaten.
Walks down to the pitch of the ball and keeps it out safely towards mid on.
Helps it on the leg side, in the gap towards mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Stretches forward to a full ball and blocks it safely.
Flighted on middle, pushed down straight to mid on.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Another arm ball on off, Woakes has no clue about it, tries to push at it tentatively and gets an inside edge through his legs. The ball goes wide of the stumps and they cross for a single.
Arm ball on middle, Woakes tries to defend but misses and is hit low on the pads.
Adil Rashid is in next. Change in bowling as Taijul Islam comes back on.

OUT! Bowled 'em! The debutant strikes again, it's a 5-fer on debut for him and he becomes the 7th bowler to achieve this feat for Bangladesh. Quicker delivery around off, skidding in off the surface as Bairstow tries to play across the line. He misses the ball completely and finds his stumps disturbed. A big breakthrough for Bangladesh. Jonny departs after playing a fine knock.
Quicker one darted down the leg side, Bairstow covers the line and then leaves it alone.
Jonny has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Shout for an lbw! Tossed up ball on off, spinning in, JB tries to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. The impact looks marginal and hence the umpire shakes his head. Bangladesh opt not to take the referral.

In the air... safe! The new hard ball offers extra bounce and it spins back in after gripping. Woakes tries to defend but gets an inside edge. It brushes his pads and goes just wide of short leg. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Quicker ball on middle, clipped through square leg for a single.
Mehedi Hasan to share the second new cherry from the other end.

FOUR! Well played! Shafiul drops it on a good length around off, Woakes tries to defend it off his front foot but there is some extra bounce and he immediately takes his bottom hand off the handle. As a result, the outside edge generated doesn't carry and runs wide of the first slip fielder for a boundary. Prior to this delivery, that zone was vacated.
Second slip moves out to short extra cover.
FOUR! Fine shot! A juicy half-volley outside off, Woakes takes his front leg to the pitch of the ball and drives it crisply through covers for a boundary.
Fullish on off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
Bit of swing there, full and outside off, Woakes drives it away from his body and places it through point for a couple.
Second new ball has been taken now.
Keeps it very full and around off, Woakes squeezes it out towards the slip cordon.
Right on the mark, fuller and around off, Chris defends it from the crease to the off side.
Shafiul Islam is back into the attack. Second new ball is due now but Bangladesh have not taken it yet.
Bairstow has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Loopy one on off, Bairstow draws forward to defend but gets a soft outside edge which doesn't carry to first slip.
Quicker and fuller on off, Bairstow defends it closer to his front pad.
Full flighted on off, a little bit of away spin, Jonny lunges and defends it.
Short again and outside off, Bairstow punches it to covers.
Flatter and shorter outside off, hit across the line but straight to mid on.
Mominul Haque to have a bowl now. Second new ball due in one over.
Tossed up outside off, Woakes defends it off his front foot to the off side.
Loopy and on middle, defended back solidly.
Bowls it with a round-arm action, around leg, Jonny sweeps it through backward square leg for a single.
Flatter and quicker outside off, Bairstow tries to push through the line but misses.
Spinning away gently, Jonny taps it down towards point.
Floated and full ball on off, Bairstow goes back and offers a straight bat in defense.
FOUR! Very poor delivery, a long hop around off, begging to be hit, Woakes goes deep inside the crease and hammer-pulls it past the diving deep mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Hits the yorker mark around off, Woakes keeps it out.
Woakes has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
11th Test fifty for Bairstow.
Shortish and on off, Bairstow punches it off his back foot to covers for a single. Another fine and important knock by Jonny, the saviour!
Fullish on off, driven back to the bowler.
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run.
Drinks break....
Flatter outside off, JB stays back and chops it down to third man for a run.
Sprayed on the pads, Woakes clips it away to the leg side for a run.
Slider outside off, Woakes reaches out and defends it solidly.
Quicker ball outside off, Woakes blocks it out firmly from the crease.
Fullish outside off, Woakes reaches out to that one and defends it well.
Tossed up outside off, Woakes gets well forward to that one and defends it well.
Tossed up fuller outside off, JB gets across and pushes it towards mid off.
Fuller on middle, JB gets across and jams it towards mid on.
Flatter on middle and leg, whipped off the back foot through mid-wicket for a brace.
A bit short and outside off, cut away to sweeper cover for a run.
Flatter outside leg, Woakes gets back to block but is rapped on the pads. Needless appeal for lbw.
Full toss on leg, Bairstow sweeps it away down to fine leg for a single.
Sabbir Rahman comes back on.
Quicker ball outside off, punched off the back foot to deep cover for a run.
Loopy outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Fuller on middle and off, Woakes leans across and pushes it to mid on.
Flatter outside off, pushed towards cover.
Flighted outside off, Woakes reaches out to that one and defends it to the covers.
Floats it up outside off, defended well off the front foot towards cover.
Fuller on middle, JB gets across to that one and blocks it nicely.
Slider outside off, Woakes camps back and jabs it to the covers for a quick single.
Tossed up outside off, Woakes drives but mistimes it back to the bowler.
Loopy on off, spinning in sharply, Bairstow tucks it with the turn through mid-wicket for a single.
Drifting in from around off, JB gets across and pats it back to the bowler.
Full outside off, Bairstow reaches out to that one and blocks it out.
Loopy outside off, Woakes reaches out and defends it well.
Fired in on middle, Woakes looks to block but is rapped on the front pad. Loud lbw shout but that was missing leg.
Floated outside off, Woakes reaches out and defends it well.
Quicker ball outside off, slapped away to deep cover for a single.
Very full outside off, Woakes gets forward and blocks it out.
Fuller on off, defended well off the front foot.
Fuller on off, worked towards mid-wicket.
2000 Test runs for Jonny Bairstow!
Fuller on off, Bairstow goes across to that one and sweeps it behind square leg for a brace.
Tossed up outside off, Bairstow gets the stride in and smothers it to the ground.
Flatter on middle, JB defends it firmly from the crease.
Fuller outside off, JB gets forward and defends it well.
IN THE AIR...BUT SAFE! Fired in on leg stump, stuck off the surface as Bairstow looks to flick. Gets a leading edge that goes in the air and just falls short of mid on.
Too full from Taijul and Bairstow creams it to sweeper cover for a single.
Darted down the leg side, Woakes fails to connect the flick and the ball rolls off the pads to short fine leg. No signal from the umpire so there might have been some bat involved.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Drops it short outside off, too wide and Woakes has enough time to play it. Essays a fine back foot punch through extra cover to find the fence.
Floats it up outside off, Woakes lunges into it and pushes it past silly point.
Speared in on middle, Jonny sweeps it away down to fine leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot.
Taijul Islam is back on.
Tossed up outside off, Bairstow leans into it and defends it out.

Four Byes! That beats everyone! Flighted off break outside off, spinning in sharply, Woakes looks to drive but misses. The ball goes between the bat and pad while also just whizzing away past leg stump. Goes to the fine leg fence where the fielder makes a good stop but the momentum took him past the ropes. 200 comes up for England!
Full and on off, Woakes gets across and pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller on off, Woakes presses forward and blocks it out.
Quicker ball outside off, defended well from the crease.
Loopy outside off, Woakes stays back and blocks it out.
Good length outside off, punched towards mid off for a single.
Full and outside off, Woakes leans into it and pushes it to the covers.
Length ball outside off, Woakes looks to drive but gets a bottom edge to cover.
Good length around off, Woakes stays back and covers the inswing to tap it towards short mid-wicket.
Pitched up on off, shaping in, JB tucks it to short mid-wicket where Mahmudullah fumbles to allow the single.
Fuller around off, tailing in, Bairstow presses forward to block well.
Chris Woakes walks in next. England bat very deep and that's one of their biggest strengths.

OUT! CRACKING BALL AND ALI GOES! Flighted delivery and Ali pushes tamely at it. The off break spins away sharply with bounce to force the edge which is well taken by Rahim behind the sticks. Ali is walking even before the umpire's finger is raised. It's been a very fine knock from him. Much-needed wicket for the hosts and they know it. A valuable 88-run stand has been broken.
Fuller on middle, Bairstow goes across and sweeps it towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Slider on a length outside off, punched off the back foot to deep cover for one.
Too full on off, Ali digs it out and finds the gap perfectly between long on and deep mid-wicket. Brace taken.
Drifting away from outside off, spinning away, Ali covers the turn and taps it to short leg.
Flighted on middle, turning sharply into Bairstow who works it with the spin down to fine leg for a run.
Banged in short on middle, JB goes for the pull but gets a bottom edge to the leg side. Single taken.
Full and tailing in a bit from around off, Bairstow gets across and pushes it towards mid on.
Dug in short on leg stump, comfortable height for Ali to nail the pull towards deep square leg. Single taken.
Length ball outside off, Moeen opens the bat face and steers it to point.
Slower ball on middle, Ali picks it early and blocks it off the front foot.
Lazy from Ali! Length ball slanting away across him. He tries to drive without footwork and is beaten by the late away movement.
Flighted on middle, Bairstow lunges to block but the ball goes off the inside half to short leg.
Fuller on off, Ali goes across and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Slider outside off, Moeen sits back and adjusts well to the low bounce. Nicely blocked off the back foot.
Quicker ball on a length outside off, defended well off the back foot.
Ripper! Nice loopy off break outside off, turn and bounce as the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Quicker ball outside off, Ali leans into it and taps it to short cover.
Full and outside off, JB reaches out and pushes it gently towards mid off.
Fullish on off, driven solidly back to the bowler by Jonny.

FOUR! Smartly played! Good length outside off, extra bounce but Bairstow adjusts well to play it with soft hands. The bat face opens out late and the steer gets past a diving gully fielder towards the third man fence.
Good length outside off, Bairstow leans forward and defends it well.
Short ball on leg stump, good height on the bumper and forces Ali into the pull. Mistimes it a bit and it was in the air too but lands safe at deep mid-wicket. Single taken.
Good length angled away outside off, Ali plays with an angled bat and chops it to gully.

FOUR! SUPERB SHOT! Flatter and short outside off, Bairstow stays back to that one and punches it through the covers for a boundary. His footwork has been so decisive today and it's been a feature of his batting.

It is a bump ball! Fired outside leg, Bairstow goes for the paddle sweep and the ball lobs high in the air. Leg gully goes back to his left to take it and the hosts appeal for a catch. There was an under edge but is it a bump ball? The umpires want to refer it and replays confirm the ball hit the ground off the under edge.
Bangladesh are appealing for a catch against Bairstow. The umpires are unsure and want to refer this to the third umpire.
Drifting in on middle and leg, JB gets across and tucks it to the leg side.
Floated on middle and leg, JB gets well forward and defends it nicely.
Darted in on middle, Bairstow goes back to drive by creating some room but can only find the man at mid off.
Flatter on middle, worked off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
Mehedi Hasan to bowl from the other end.
On the pads, Jonny bunts it behind square leg for a single. The keeper runs across to his left to stop the ball and hence the batsmen give up the thought of pinching the second run.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Good length ball angling down the leg side, Bairstow fails to work it across the line and it clips his pads on its way back. Rahim dives to stop the ball but fails to do so and the batsmen collect a couple of leg byes. It seems Rahim has hurt his fingers but is ready to continue.
Full in length and angling into the right-hander, Bairstow defends it off his pads to one of the two short mid-wicket fielders.
Angles across a length ball outside off, Moeen gets forward and pushes it with an angled bat through cover-point for a single.
Starts with a length ball around off, Moeen stays back footed in defense and pushes it out to covers.

Welcome back for the final session! The players are back on the field. 28 overs left in the day's play owing to a superb over-rate maintained by the home side. Shafiul Islam to begin proceedings. Let's see if he gets some reverse swing. Here we go...
.....DAY 1, SESSION 3.....

The debutant Mehedi once again shone for the hosts although he tired a bit later on. Shakib and Taijul were also quite accurate although they weren't rewarded for their efforts. Shakib did get the wicket of Stokes but he's been a bit unlucky too thereafter. Rahim has tried almost all of his spin options on this wearing surface but the Ali-Bairstow stand has frustrated Bangladesh. A first innings total over 250 could be really challenging. Join us in a while for the final session.

34 OVERS, 92 RUNS AND 2 WICKETS. A much better session for England although Bangladesh won't be too disappointed. The first hour once again belonged to the hosts with the big wicket of Root followed by another important strike of Stokes. Ali has continued to hold fort with a fine mix of caution and aggression. He along with a fairly aggressive Bairstow has managed to bring some balance to the game situation with their unbeaten fifty partnership.
Flighted outside off, Bairstow reaches out to that one and defends it well. THAT SHALL BE TEA ON DAY 1.
Shorter in length on middle, Bairstow gets back to that one and blocks it out.
Tossed up around off, Bairstow looks to block but the ball goes off the inside half towards the leg side.
Fuller on off, Jonny gets forward to that one and defends it well.
Quicker and full outside off, JB gets across to that one and pushes it to cover.
Floats it up on middle, Bairstow gets across to that one and defends it well.
Drifting in from around off, Ali gets forward to that one and blocks.
Full and outside off, Ali leans forward and eases it to the covers.
Slider on middle, Moeen goes back and taps it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller on middle and off, Ali pushes it back to the bowler.
Quicker ball on middle and off, Ali blocks it well from the crease.
Fuller on middle and off, worked away to the leg side.
Quicker ball outside off, defended nicely from the crease.
Very full on off, Bairstow gets forward and digs it out to the bowler.
Flatter outside off, pushed off the back foot to mid off for a single.
Flighted around off, Ali pushes at it and gets it off the inside half past short leg.
Tossed up on a length on off, Ali stays back and works it to mid-wicket.
Floats it up outside off, Ali gets well forward to block and is rapped on the front pad. Impact well outside the line.
Shakib Al Hasan comes on for a fresh spell.
Tossed up on middle and off, Bairstow pushes at it and the ball goes off the inside half to the leg side.
Slider on middle, Bairstow stays back and pats it back to the bowler.
Flighted outside off, JB presses forward to that one and defends it to silly point.
Fired in on a length on off, worked off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
Drifting in from outside off, spinning away, Bairstow lets it pass.
Quicker ball closer to off, Bairstow presses forward and blocks it well.

FOUR! Ali's on the charge now! Flighted outside off, Ali sees the length in his zone and launches it straight back down the ground. Aerial stroke but well past mid off to find the second boundary of the over.
Fuller outside off, Ali reaches out to that one and defends it well.
FOUR! THAT'S A TERRIFIC STROKE! Floated fuller on off, languid bat swing of Ali sends the ball over wide mid on with absolute ease. Clean strike and that's another boundary to the southpaw.
Quicker ball on off, Ali goes back to flick and adjusts to clip it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller around off, Ali digs it out back to the bowler.
Slider on a length on off, pushed off the back foot to the covers.
Fuller on middle and off, Ali thumps it down the ground to long on for a single.
Slider on middle and off, keeps a bit low and Ali adjusts well to block it to forward short leg.
Floats it up on middle, quicker in pace as Ali defends it well off the back foot.
Darted in on middle, Moeen sits back and tucks it past forward short leg.
Flighted around off, Ali presses forward to that one and blocks it well.
Fuller on off, Ali gets across to that one and works it to the leg side.

FOUR! Hammered! Bairstow continues to motor along! Drops it short on middle, sits back to that one and pulls it through square leg to find the fence. He is playing a really fluent knock here and putting pressure on the hosts.
Flatter outside off, blocked well off the back foot.
Flatter on middle, spinning to rap Bairstow on the pads. The ball lobs near leg slip.
Fuller on middle, JB reaches out and works it to short mid-wicket.

FOUR! Bad ball and punished! Drops it short outside off, Bairstow continues to pounce on the offerings and cuts it away through point to find the fence. Good batting this as it's vital to put the bad balls away especially on a pitch like this. 50-run stand comes up, sixth between this pair in this year, most by any. It shows they have been the saviours for England in the recent past. Something similar expected from them again.
Leg slip comes in.
Floats it up on a length outside off, turning away, Ali steers it to point for a single.
Mahmudullah comes on to bowl.
Flatter on middle and off, blocked well from the crease.
Loopy outside off, spinning away with big bounce. No shot offered by Jonny.
Drifting away from outside off, turning away as JB pushes at it. The ball goes off the outer half towards cover.
Quicker ball on middle, Bairstow sits on the back foot and defends it well.
Flatter on middle, shorter in length and Bairstow blocks it off the back foot to mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, JB gets forward to that one and pushes it towards point.
Pitched up on off, Ali gets across and pushes it straight back at the bowler.
Shortish outside off, Ali chases it seeing the width but fails to make contact.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to the covers.
8th Test fifty for Moeen Ali!

FOUR! That was risky! Shortish outside off, Ali goes back to play the back foot drive but cannot quite keep it down. Two men at short cover and it goes through them before racing away to the fence. All the luck seems to be with Ali today. It's been a clever knock nevertheless and has come at a very crucial time for England.
Length ball outside off, no shot offered to that one.

FOUR! Poor start to a new spell! Low full toss outside off, Ali doesn't miss out on the offering and thumps it past mid off to find the fence. It's high time that Rabbi starts hitting his straps. He's been ordinary to say the least and should look to take a leaf out of the other debutant Mehedi.
Kamrul Islam Rabbi comes on for another spell.
Edged but doesn't carry! Quicker and fuller outside off, turns sharply to get the outside edge. Falls short of Rahman at slip.
Fuller outside off, Bairstow leans forward and pushes it to cover.
Darted in from outside off, JB stays in the crease and defends well.
Flatter outside off, defended well off the back foot.

FOUR! NICELY PLAYED! Drifting in short from outside off, Bairstow sits back to that one and punches it through the covers. Timed it well and found the gap to perfection to get a boundary. This is a very positive knock from the keeper batsman so far.
Tossed up outside off, JB presses forward to that one and pushes it to cover.
Tossed up outside off, Ali gets across to play a premeditated sweep. Bobbles up in the air but well past Rahim down to fine leg. Brace taken.
Tossed up gently around off, Ali covers the line and blocks it off the front foot.
Fuller on off, Ali gets well forward to that one and blocks it.
Quicker ball outside off, defended well off the back foot to the covers.
That one spun! Drifting away from outside off, sharp turn after pitching as Ali plays well inside the line.
Flighted just outside off, Ali reaches out to that one and blocks it firmly.
Full and outside off, JB reaches out and pushes it to point.
Fired in fuller on off, JB presses forward and blocks it out.
Sliding in short from outside off, pushed off the back foot to the covers.
Fuller on off, Bairstow covers the line and dead bats it away.
Drops it a bit short outside off, Bairstow goes back to cut but mistimes it towards cover.
Floats it up around off, Bairstow gets well forward and blocks it well.
Fullish on middle, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller on off, dug out through mid on for a single.
Switches to around the wicket.

FOUR! HAMMERED! Ali's footwork is preying on the young Mehedi who drops it short on middle, Moeen sits back and crunches the pull through wide mid on to find the fence. Good attacking batting this from the southpaw.
Flighted outside off, Ali presses forward and blocks it out.

SIX! Beautiful shot! Flighted on middle and leg, Ali steps out to that one and lofts it cleanly over long on for a maximum. This is very smart batting from the southpaw, trying to put pressure right back on the debutant.
Tossed up around off, Ali defends it firmly from the crease.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
Fuller down the leg side, Bairstow goes for the sweep but misses.

DROPPED! Bangladesh shouldn't put down such simple chances. Nicely flighted outside off, Bairstow goes for the booming drive and gets an outside edge. Rahman at slip is late to react and the ball hits him on the knee before falling in front of him.
Quicker ball on off, Bairstow leans into it and taps it towards silly point.
Drifting in from around off, JB gets well forward and blocks it out.
Fuller around off, flatter in trajectory as Bairstow pushes it off the front foot to point.
Fuller ball around off, blocked well off the front foot.
Flighted on off, Ali uses his feet and defends it well.

ALI SURVIVES ANOTHER REVIEW! Floats it up on middle, Ali gets forward to block and expects the ball to turn but it doesn't. Skids through to rap him on the front pad. Loud lbw appeal but turned down. Seemed like it pitched outside leg but Rahim opts for the review. Hawk Eye confirms that the ball was pitching outside leg. The on-field call is upheld. Bangladesh have now exhausted both their reviews.
Bangladesh have taken a review for lbw against Ali. It's raining reviews today when he is on strike, isn't it? Where this pitched will be the question.
Drifting away on off, Ali steps out and defends it towards cover.
Loopy around off, Ali gets the stride in and blocks it out nicely.
Fuller around off, Ali gets well forward and defends it well.
Mehedi Hasan to continue. He's bowled tirelessly and in long spells, that too on debut.
Fullish around off, Bairstow defends it firmly from the crease.
Loopy on a length on leg stump, Bairstow shuffles across and taps it towards mid-wicket.
Sliding in from outside off, shorter in length and Bairstow blocks it off the back foot.
Flatter and fuller around off, defended well off the front foot.
Drifting in outside off, a touch shorter as Bairstow stays back to defend.
Quicker ball outside off, spinning away, Bairstow lunges into it to block.
Taijul Islam comes back on.
Drinks break. Another good hour after lunch for Bangladesh. They have bowled 18 overs so far in it and have kept the English batsmen guessing. The wicket of Joe Root was a big boost for them.
Tossed up ball around leg, spinning away a touch, Moeen gets forward and softly defends it to short leg.
Defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Powered away! A flighted delivery served by Hasan, Moeen got down on one knee, fetched it from outside off and swept it firmly to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Flighted and on middle, Moeen offers a vertical bat in defense. Solid!
Quicker one on off, a touch shorter as well, Moeen punches it from the back foot to covers.
Slow loopy ball dipping in around middle, Moeen defends it with gentle hands.
Gets back to a short ball and punches it straight to the cover fielder.
Lunges to a full ball and defends it with the spin to the off side.
Floated one outside off, Jonny gets forward with a big stride and shoulders arms.
Fires a quicker one down the leg side, Bairstow fails to put bat on ball and the keeper also fails to stop it. A couple of byes taken.

FOUR! Great piece of batting by Jonny! He is not letting any bad ball go unpunished! Shakib drags his length short outside off, Bairstow goes deep inside the crease and slaps it through cover-point for a boundary.
Floated full ball on off, it's driven off the front foot past silly point but straight to covers.
Slower through the air and full outside off, Jonny pushes it gently in the gap at covers for a single.
Gets forward to a full ball and dead bats it near the surface.
Spinning down the leg side, from a fuller length around middle, Bairstow fails to flick and is hit on the pads.
Floated off spinner on middle, Bairstow gets on the front foot and defends it down safely.
Goes down on one knee and sweeps it off the inner half of the bat through square leg. A single taken.
Flighted ball on off, spinning away, Moeen goes back and defends it down.

FOUR! Another fine shot! Shakib tosses it up in the air but fails to land it, Bairstow reaches out and receives the full toss with a glee and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary. 1000 Test runs for him this year, only the second wicket keeper to do this in a calendar year after Andy Flower.
FOUR! Shakib bowls it with a round-arm action and lands it very full outside leg, Bairstow paddle sweeps it fine down the leg side and it beats the slide from the fielder in the deep.
Slower through the air, full and around off, Bairstow prods forward in defense.
Shortish on middle, it's turned through mid-wicket for a single.
Strides forward to a full ball and defends it down.
Fires a full ball on middle, Moeen hits it to short mid-wicket where the fielder dives to stop the ball.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flighted full ball on middle, Bairstow is forward as he defends it to mid-wicket.
Pitched outside leg, Jonny pads it away.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Shortish outside off, Moeen half-heartedly pushes it to the off side.

Flatter and shorter on off, Moeen gets back and hits it firmly towards mid on. The fielder slides to his left to stop the ball from racing away. It's not a clean stop though but still the batsmen decide not to risk a run.
Flighted and full on off, Jonny defends it off his front foot. End of a super over, a wicket maiden!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Jonny Bairstow is the new batsman.

OUT! Clattered! Shakib produces a beauty to breach Stokes' defense. He tosses it up in the air, slower in pace, it lands full around off and spins back in a shade to beat the forward defensive prod by Stokes. It sneaks through and strikes the top of off stump. What a sight for a spinner! Smart thinking by the bowler, the last delivery kept its line after landing and this one spun back in to fool the batsman. Terrific stuff!
Throws up a quicker one outside off, Stokes leaves it alone.
Goes back inside the crease and works it with the spin to square leg. Once again finds the fielder.
Flatter delivery on middle and leg, Stokes hangs back and hits it to mid-wicket.
Fuller and on off, it's driven off the front foot to mid off.
Loopy full ball on off, Ali defends it by pressing forward.
Slow spin away from the southpaw, Moeen allows it through to the keeper.
Strides forward to a full ball and pushes it to mid off.
Short and wide outside off, Moeen punches it off his back foot but straight to the cover fielder. Missed out on a boundary ball.
Flighted and full around off, Moeen kneels and sweeps it in front of square leg for a couple of runs.
Loopy full ball on off, Ben defends it off his front foot.
Quicker ball around leg, Stokes flicks it to short leg.
Extra flight on this occasion, full and around off, Stokes defends it off his front foot.
Flatter ball on middle, Stokes goes back and whips it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Full and spinning down, Stokes helps it down to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Turning into the batsman from around off, Stokes goes back in defense.
Drifting into the batsman, landing around off and spinning away, Stokes covers the line and leaves it alone.
Fuller ball on off, driven towards mid off for a quick single.
Quicker one on off, fuller in length, Moeen quietly flicks it past short leg and collects a single.
Gentle away spin from around off, Moeen defends it off his front foot.
Flighted full around off, Moeen defends it off his front foot.
Flatter and shorter on off, spinning away, Moeen goes back and punches it to short cover.
Spinning down the leg side, Stokes tries to sweep but misses.
Presses forward to a full ball and defends it with the spin to short leg.
Lunges to a full ball and defends it to the off side.
Flatter and shorter on middle, Stokes goes back and punches it to the bowler.
Flighted full ball on off, Moeen lunges in defense.
Quicker flatter ball on middle, Stokes goes on the back foot in defense.
Bowls it with a slinging action and darts in a fuller ball on off, Moeen keeps it out on the off side.
Ali has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Turning away from the batsman after landing on off, Moeen goes back, pushes at it and misses.
Flatter and shorter on off, Moeen gets back and turns it across the line. Finds mid on.
Flighted full ball on off, Ali defends it from the front foot.
The batsman has played it to the point region.

SIX! Wonderful footwork by Stokes as he jumps down to the pitch of the delivery and swings it with the spin over mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep is standing up and has to run back. But the ball goes wide of him and lands flush on the ropes. The umpire checks upstairs before signalling a biggie.
Tossed up ball on off, defended back to the bowler.
Tickles it with the spin through square leg for one.
Flat and full, around middle, swept through square leg for a single.
Loopy ball around off, Stokes defends it off his front foot.
Full floated ball on middle, spinning down, Stokes tries to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. It comes off the back of the bat and flies wide of first slip.
Flighted and full on off, defended off the front foot.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Gets back to a shortish ball and punches it to the off side.
Spinning square on this occasion after landing around off, Ali tries to defend but misses.

Drags his length short and lands it around off, Stokes immediately goes back and punches it through the line. It's uppish but wide of short cover. Shafiul does well from mid off to stop it with a slide. A single taken.
Full floated ball on middle, Stokes gets forward and offers a straight bat in defense.
Full and around off, Moeen defends it wristily to short mid-wicket.
Presses forward to a full ball and defends it.
Flighted on middle, defended softly to short leg.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, Stokes goes down and sweeps it with the spin to fine leg for a single.
Quicker and fuller on off, Stokes defends right under his watchful eyes.
Goes on the back foot and plays it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball on off, Moeen defends it off his front foot to point. Tidy over!
A touch flatter and on off, Ali goes back and punches it to the off side, not in the gap.
Ali strides forward and defends it watchfully with soft hands.
Slider around off, Stokes gets forward to defend but it takes an inside edge and rolls through mid-wicket for a run.
Big spin, wow. Landing around off and curling away, Stokes goes back and leaves it alone.
Tossed up ball on off, too full in length, Stokes lunges to defend.
Flighted and outside off, Stokes defends it off his back foot to end the over.
Bowls it slower through the air and lands it full around middle, Stokes defends it off his pads to short leg.
Quicker and fuller on middle, it's swept through square leg by Stokes for a single.
Loopy full ball on off, Ali lunges and pushes it through mid on for a single.
Tossed up ball on middle, turning down, Stokes gets back and helps it through square leg for a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Shortish and outside off, Ali gets back to cut but fails to connect. End of a successful over!
Flatter on middle and off, defended off the back foot.
Flighted ball outside off, left alone.
Too full in length and around leg, Stokes works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Ben Stokes arrives.

OUT! Root falls! This is a body blow to England. Mehedi bowls from around the wicket and delivers a full floated ball around off, it straightens a touch after landing as Root lunges to defend. But it takes the outer half of the bat, screams behind and pops out off the keeper's pads. Sabbir stationed at first slip does well to react and takes a good catch. Root departs after showing good form. Bangladesh on top!
Flighted full ball outside off, Root gets forward and drives it through covers for a couple of runs.
Debutant Mehedi Hasan to bowl from the other end after lunch.
Flatter and on middle, Ali defends it off his back foot. End of a very eventful over!

Tossed up ball on middle, Ali draws forward and pushes it off the outside half of the bat to point. The fielder charges to the ball, fumbles and Moeen looks for a run. But his partner ain't interested.

NOT OUT! Impact indeed saves Moeen! Floated full ball landing around off, spinning in, Ali gets forward and across to play the sweep shot but misses. He is thudded on the pads, they appeal and the finger goes up again. Ali opts for the review and the replays show that the impact was clearly outside off. Moeen using the technology fully to his advantage.
Once again Moeen Ali has been adjudged lbw. He takes the DRS immediately. It looks like the impact is just outside off. Let's see...
Straightaway Moeen walks down the track to smother the spin and defends it softly to the leg side.

NOT OUT! Shakib serves a full ball outside off and gets it to spin back into the batsman. Moeen strides forward to defend it with a straight bat but is beaten due to the inward spin. He is rapped on the pads, they appeal and the finger goes up after a bit of a delay. Ali once again opts for the review. The third umpire has a close look at it, there is no inside edge, impact is in line but the ball is spinning too much and is missing leg. Another good review by Moeen!
Moeen Ali is given lbw again. He has reviewed it...
Starts with a full delivery down the leg side, quicker and flatter through the air, Ali leaves it alone.

We're back for the afternoon session. The men concerned are back on the field. The pitch usually settles down into a good batting one after lunch in this part of the world and England will be hoping that the current partnership prospers and bring them back on track. Bangladesh on the other hand will be eyeing early wicket. Shakib Al Hasan to begin proceedings. Here we go...
DAY 1, SESSION 2...

Mehedi Hasan was the star performer, showing immense temperament on debut. The other bowlers were a mixed bag with Taijul being relatively the better of the lot. It must be said that Rahim's captaincy in the second hour defied logic with him bringing on Rabbi for a spell that seemed unnecessary with the ball spinning so much. With the track turning drastically, we could be in for a low-scoring game. Join us in a while for the second session.

A good session for Bangladesh although England did quite well in the second hour. Cook's decision to bat was neutralized to an extent with the ball turning sharply right from the start. The debutant Duckett and his skipper departed quickly before Ballance was trapped in front lbw, leaving England tottering at 21/3. Since then, Root and Ali have repaired things a bit with a valuable unbroken fifty partnership although the latter has survived some really close calls.
Flatter on a length around off, worked off the back foot to long on for a single. THAT SHALL BE LUNCH ON DAY 1.
Floats it up on a length outside off, spinning in as Ali offers no stroke to it. Gets rapped on the back pad but it's too high as the lbw appeal is turned down.
Drifting in on middle and leg, Ali leans across and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller on off, Ali gets forward and defends it out.
Floats it up outside off, a bit fuller as Ali is beaten on the back foot block. Extra bounce too!
Drops it short on middle and leg, half-hearted pull from Root towards deep mid-wicket. Single taken.
Another debutant in action. This time it's Sabbir Rahman who will bowl. He is a part-time leg spinner.
Fuller ball spinning down the leg side, Ali looks to flick but misses.

NOT OUT! Floats it up around off, Ali reaches out to sweep but is struck on the pads. Big lbw appeal and the umpire's finger goes up.  He opts for the review. It is a legal ball and they check to see if the fielder at forward short leg is in front of square as otherwise it would be a no ball for three fielders being behind square on the leg side. That is fine too. The inside edge is being checked on and Ultra Edge does detect it. So, that puts an end to the debate. The decision is overturned and Ali survives.
Ali has been given out lbw. He has opted for the review.
Full on off, defends it well from the crease.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
Ali goes aerial! Flighted on leg stump, Ali steps out to that one and wrists it uppishly over wide mid on. The ball goes to the deep where it is well stopped. Brace taken.
Quicker ball on middle and off, blocked well off the back foot.
Flatter and a bit short on leg stump, worked off the back foot through square leg for a single.
Four Byes! Loopy around off, spins in sharply to go down the leg side. Rahim cannot judge the awkward bounce and turn as the ball gets through him to the ropes.
Flighted outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
50-run stand between Root and Ali.
Loopy on middle and leg, Root goes across to sweep it cheekily down to fine leg. Picked the length early and took it on the full. Brace taken.
Flighted just outside off, Root gets the stride in and defends it to short cover.
Tossed up outside off, flowing drive from Root but straight to cover.
Slider on middle and leg, this time Root plays the sweep well down to fine leg. Single taken.
Quicker and short on leg stump, Root goes for the pull initially and then decides to play a lap sweep. Hits Mominul at forward short leg.
Flatter in trajectory around off, Root reaches out and pushes it to short cover.
Floats it up outside off, Root reaches out to that one and blocks it out.
Fuller outside off, Ali pushes at it and gets a thick inside edge behind square leg for a run.
Tossed up fuller outside off, Root eases it towards cover for a brisk single.
Shakib Al Hasan is back on.

FOUR! SMASHED! Long hop from Islam and on this pitch, that's a crime. Sits up nicely for Ali to maul the pull through square leg for a boundary. Spoils what was a really testing over till this delivery.
Drifting in around off, Ali steps out to work it away but misses. The ball lobs off the front pad to the vacant silly point region.

NOT OUT! Loopy just outside off, spinning in, Ali pushes at it but is rapped on the front pad. Huge appeal for lbw which is turned down by the umpire. Bangladesh decide to gamble with the review. No inside edge spotted and Ultra Edge confirms it. However, impact is marginally outside the line which means it's umpire's call. It would have only clipped leg stump anyway. So, Ali survives.
Bangladesh have taken a review for lbw against Ali.
More excitement! Loopy on middle, spins in sharply as Ali pushes at it. Gets a thick inside edge that flies to the right of leg slip and goes to the deep. Brace added.
Loopy on off, spinning in as Ali goes for the sweep but misses to be rapped on the pads. Loud lbw appeal but turned down. Probably spun too much.
Tossed up on off, spinning in, Ali clips it towards forward short leg.
FOUR! Rabbi continues to leak runs! Short and too wide outside off, Root has all the time in the world to steer it well past the gully fielder to the third man fence.
Pitched up once more outside off, Root reaches out and pushes it towards short cover.
Fuller outside off, extended forward defense from Root as the ball goes to short cover.
Good length closer to off, Root hangs back and jabs it towards gully.
Short of a length outside off, Root looks to run it down to third man almost as an afterthought. Straight to the man at gully.
Length ball outside off, keeps a bit low as Root tries to block but is beaten as the ball goes under his bat.
Floats it up around off, slower through the air again, Ali presses forward to block.
Loopy on off, spinning in, Ali looks to flick but the ball goes off the pads just besides FSL.
Flighted closer to off, Moeen gets the stride in and defends it well.
Quicker ball on middle and off, Moeen gets back and works it to the leg side.
Drifting in around off, Ali gives the charge and adjusts to block it out as the length was shortened.
Floats it up on off, Ali gets across and clips it towards forward short leg.
Taijul Islam comes on to bowl. A slip, short leg and a leg slip in place.
Dug in short around leg stump, not much bounce and Ali easily pulls it down to fine leg for a single.
Fuller on middle and off, Ali closes the bat face a bit too early and gets a leading edge towards mid off.
Good length angled away just around off, blocked off the back foot to the off side.
Fuller and around off, Ali stands tall and punches it towards mid off.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to deep point. Single taken.
Length ball outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Drifting away on a length outside off, Moeen hangs back and offers the full face of the blade to block.
Darted in a touch shorter around off, Ali stays back and blocks it out.
Sliding in from outside off, pushed off the back foot to short cover.
Tossed up nicely closer to off, Ali gets forward and smothers it.
Fuller outside off, Ali gets forward and defends it well.
Floats it up around leg stump, Root sweeps it just past leg slip. Came off the toe end of the blade and the batsmen take a single.
Good length angled away outside off, decent bounce and carry as Ali leaves.

Dug in short around off, Ali takes his eyes off to evade but the bumper hardly rises. Goes to the keeper on the second bounce. Inconsistent bounce and we are just in the second hour of the first session on day 1!
Wide! A bumper that is way down the leg side and too high as well. No shot offered from Ali. Wide signalled.
Length ball on middle and leg, a bit of extra bounce as Ali gets across to dab it towards forward short leg.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Fullish ball outside off, in the slot for Ali who drives it sweetly through the covers. Picked the gap and timed it really well to get the boundary.
Good length angling away across Ali who punches it off the back foot towards short cover.

Length ball well outside off, Root plays it with an angled bat towards gully. Direct hit at the keeper's end by Mehedi but it wasn't really needed as the batsman was well in. The rebound goes towards short fine leg and a run results.
Sharp turn! Floated up around off, the off break spins away drastically to fizz past Ali's outside edge.
Shortens his length on middle and leg, Root stays back and tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted fuller on middle and leg, Root digs it out back to the bowler.
Slider on middle and leg, Root hangs back and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Leg bye! Drifting in on leg stump, Ali looks to flick but the ball goes off the pads down the leg side towards short fine leg. The batsmen get a leg bye.
Tossed up on off, Ali reaches out and dead bats it away.
Good length just around off, Root hangs back and chops it to the off side.
Length ball closer to off, Root stands tall and blocks it firmly towards mid on.
Good length on the pads, Rabbi's losing his radar and Root tucks it nicely behind square leg for a brace. Good tumbling stop near the fence.
FOUR! PURE CLASS! Full ball outside off, Rabbi overcompensates in line and Root dishes out a cracking cover drive on the up. Nobody budged as that rocketed to the fence. Top shot!
FOUR! CLIPPED AWAY! Gift from Rabbi as he sprays the ball way down the leg side. Root only had to get some bat on it and does so to tickle it down to the fine leg fence.
Fuller and a hint of shape into Root who gets across to push it towards mid on.
Kamrul Islam Rabbi is back on. A slip and a gully in place.
Another quicker ball outside off, not much spin again and Ali makes another leave.
The arm ball from Mehedi and Ali lets it skid through to the keeper.
Flighted around off, Ali gets forward and covers the line well to block.
Floats it up on middle and leg, Ali goes for the aggressive sweep but is rapped on the front pad. Appeal for lbw but turned down. Marginal call that.
Loopy and full on off, Moeen is forward in defense.
Flighted ball on middle, Root goes on the back foot and works it through square leg for a single.
Drinks break! First hour to Bangladesh.

Floated and full ball on middle, Moeen defends it off his pads to short leg. End of the first hour and it's all Bangladesh. They have bowled 15 overs and have picked three top order English wickets. Great start for the hosts!

Fullish and outside off, Root pushes it gently to point. It's straight to the fielder who has an unnecessary shy at the striker's end, quite wide of the keeper and they cross for an overthrow. Sloppy from Bangladesh!
Goes on the back foot to a shortish ball and punches it towards mid on.
Loopy ball on off, an arm ball, Root lunges and defends it off the inside portion of the bat.
Tossed up and on middle, too full in length, Root gets forward in defense.
Slower delivery, full and around off, Root goes on the back foot in defense.
Presses forward to a full ball and keeps it out with a straight bat. Another lovely over by the debutant.
Slower off spinner outside off, Moeen goes back and defends it to the off side.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and defends it to the off side.

A little short in length around off, Root goes back and helps it on its way past backward square leg. The fielder chases it and does well to pull it back in play just before the rope. They take three runs.
Spinning down the leg side, flatter through the air, Root works it off his pads to backward square leg.
Quicker and very full on middle, Moeen works it just past of short leg and takes a single.
Tossed up fuller on off, Root gets forward and blocks it out nicely.
FOUR! NICELY DONE! Floats it up on a length around off, Root stays back to that one and whips it away powerfully through mid-wicket. Tough stroke to play against the spin but he executed it well.
Flatter outside off, Root stays back and jams it towards cover.
Good ball! Loopy on a length on off, low bounce as Root gets back to block. Ball goes off the outer half towards slip. Hesitation in running but no harm done eventually.
Square leg drops back.
FOUR! POSITIVE BLOW! Full outside off, Root frees his arms and nails the sweep to perfection through mid-wicket. Good batting from England's vice-captain. He will look to unsettle the spinners.
That was close! It's all happening at the moment. Drifting in just outside off, Root makes a leave as that comes in with the angle just past the off stump.
Surprise! Surprise! Moeen Ali has got a promotion in the batting order.

OUT! That's dead plumb in front! Mehedi, you beauty! Dishes out his variation delivery after bowling a few offies, fires in a slider around off and it skids on after pitching. Ballance goes on the back foot, thinking it to spin away but it keeps coming towards him. He immediately tries to bring his bat down in defense but it seems the ball has brushed the pads first. Bangladesh appeal straightaway for an lbw but the umpire shakes his head. Rahim, who has seen everything from quite close to the stumps is quick to take the DRS. The replays confirm that it has hit the pads first and rest is history. You cannot get more plumb than this. Gary is out of here and Bangladesh are taking a firm grip on this Test.
Appeal for an lbw! Not given. Rahim quickly takes the review.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Big spin away from the southpaw, Ballance feels for it and gets beaten.

Flighted and outside off, Ballance leaves it alone. Rahim screams from behind the stumps - "Come on. Hasan! One coming in, one coming out!" He is just making sure to put doubts in the batsman's mind by speaking in English, instead of Bangla. Smart from Mushfiqur!
Tossed up ball on middle, Ballance gets forward and defends it off the inside half of the bat.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.

Catch it is the shout! A touch short in length on off, spinning away a bit, Root goes back to defend, is squared up and the ball spins away big to beat his bat. It spins past first slip and they cross. The umpire has given it as a bye.
Flatter and shorter outside off, spinning away a touch, Root goes on the back foot and punches it to short extra cover.
Flighted and around middle, Ballance goes back and punches it through mid-wicket for a run.
Flighted on middle and leg, defended off the pads to the leg side.
Gary Ballance is the new batsman.

OUT! Whoa, Cook is bowled round his legs! What a start for Shakib and Bangladesh! A flighted ball landing around leg, Cook sits down on one knee to play the sweep shot but fails to connect. It hits him on the gloves, pops out and to his dismay goes on to fall on the stumps. The Bangla players are ecstatic, they have hunted down England's big fish.
Appeal for a catch! Tossed up ball around leg, Cook tries defending but misses. It pops out of his pads and the leg slip fielder catches the ball. They appeal but umpire Dharmasena shakes his head.
Shakib Al Hasan comes into the attack. As mentioned already, there is plenty of spin on offer. All the best England. A slip, short leg and leg slip in place. Test cricket is beautiful to watch.
Floated off spinner on middle, it's defended off the pads to short mid-wicket. Wicket maiden!
Joe Root is the new man in.

OUT! Sound of timber! A beautifully bowled off spinner, landing around middle and spinning away, Duckett gets forward and tries to play the trajectory but it curves past his bat to disturb the stumps. Debutant gets debutant and it's a superb start for Bangladesh. Plenty of spin on offer already.
Lunges to a full ball in defense.
Gets forward to a full ball and defends it to the off side.
Flatter arm ball on middle, Duckett tries to flick but misses and it goes off his pads to point.
Tossed up ball on off, slower through the air, Duckett defends it back.
Fullish and outside off, Ben plays it a little late and pushes it past the diving cover fielder for a single.
Full length ball on off, Duckett taps it down to covers and looks for a run. But it has gone straight to the fielder and Cook sends him back.
Harmless delivery, full and quite wide outside off, an easy leave for Ben.
On a length and just outside off, Duckett goes on the back foot in defense.
Full and outside off, plenty of width on offer and Duckett pounces onto it. He hits it through the line, a bit aerial but it goes safely to point.
Bowls with a slinging action and angles across a length ball outside off, Duckett flashes from the back foot and misses. He needs to control his rash shots.
Debutant Kamrul Islam Rabbi is introduced into the attack. He has been given a couple of slips to work with along with a gully.
Tossed up ball on off, Cook leans forward and offers a copybook defensive shot.
A slider on off, skidding in, Cook goes back and cuts it straight to point.
Too full in length on this occasion, around off, Cook jams it down safely.
Beauty! Drifting into the batsman around off, Cook strides forward to defend but it curls away to beat the outside edge. Good take by the keeper.
Loopy and around middle, Cook lunges with a straight bat in defense.
Flighted off spinner on off, Cook defends it off his front foot to short cover.
Slower delivery on off, a cutter, Duckett defends it from the crease to the off side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! First shot of real conviction from Ben Duckett! Full in length and outside off, the debutant presses forward and unfurls a lovely cover drive for a boundary.
On a length and outside off, Ben shoulders arms.

Shafiul runs from around the wicket and drops it on a length around off, it straightens a bit and Duckett plays inside the line. He gets squared up a shade and the outside edge races past gully for a couple of runs.
Change of angle by the bowler.
Full in length and outside off, angling away, Duckett throws his bat at it but fails to connect.
Tossed up ball on off, defended off the front foot by Cook. End of a testing over!
Pushes this one quicker through the air and lands it a bit short too, it's around middle, Cook goes on the back foot and eases it to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Drifting into the batsman around off, Cook tries to defend but it spins away to beat the outside edge.
Cook has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Quicker arm ball on off, Cook defends it off the inside half of the bat to the leg side.

Ho! Ho! Ho! A lovely off spinner outside off, landing and spinning away, Cook is on the front foot in defense but is beaten. That didn't bounce much either. If this is the sign of things to come, all the best to batsmen!
Length delivery in the zone around middle, Duckett defends it off his pads to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Flashes and flashes hard! Shafiul offers width outside off, it's short and wide, Duckett throws his bat at it and sends it flying over gully for a boundary. Didn't quite middle it.
On a length and just around off, Duckett gets behind the line and defends it down watchfully.
Better line, around off on a fuller length, Duckett gets behind the line in defense.
This one is too wide outside off to bother the batsman.
Length ball outside off, Duckett allows it through to the keeper.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Flatter full ball on off, an off spinner, Duckett gets forward and defends it with firm hands. Keeps it out off the outside half of the bat. It seems the English debutant isn't picking the Bangladesh debutant. Good battle!

Oohhhh... that missed the off stump by a whisker! A slider landing just outside off and skidding on with the angle, Duckett leaves it alone thinking it to be a big off spinner. Nearly clipped the off pole. Very brave leave by the debutant.
Quicker one on off, defended off the back foot by Duckett.
Flatter and short on off, Duckett goes on the back foot and punches it to covers.
Well wide outside off, Cook has an easy leave. End of a probing over.
After two outswingers, Shafiul dishes out an inswinger around middle, Cook nudges it through mid-wicket and gets off the mark with a couple of runs.

Another play and a miss. The English skipper is getting a bit itchy at the moment. A little bit of width on offer around off, angling away, Cook tries forcing it through the line without any footwork but misses it. Once again Rahim gets a bit excited but nothing in the end.

HUGE SHOUT FOR AN LBW! A rash shot attempted by Cook. He goes for the cut shot from the back foot to a shortish delivery around off but the bounce gets a bit big on his bat and he ends up missing it. Rahim collects the ball and as an afterthought goes for an appeal. Nothing from the umpire. They think about reviewing it but Rahim ain't sure and decides against using the DRS. The Ultra Edge detects nothing.
Angles across a full ball on off, Cook pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Full in length and around off, Cook gets forward and defends it near his front pad.
Floated and on off, defended off the front foot to end the over.
Beaten! Terrific change up delivery by Hasan. Bowls a slider around off, a touch on the shorter side, Duckett goes back to cut but it skids in to beat the inside edge.
Loopy and around off, Ben strides forward in defense.
Tossed up ball outside off, Duckett lets it through to the keeper.
Full flighted and outside off, Duckett drives it right through the gap at covers and gets off the mark in Test cricket with a couple of runs. The butterflies in his stomach would have settled now.
An extra slip comes into place now.
Play and a miss! A flighted off spinner outside off, bowled from around the wicket, Duckett chases it, tries to hit through the line but misses.
Spin from the other end! Debutant Mehedi Hasan to bowl his offies. A slip, short leg and short cover in place...
Angles across a full ball outside off, Cook covers the line and shoulders arms. Decent first over by Shafiul!
Lands it full and around off, Cook draws forward in defense.
Full in length and around off, Cook plays it close to his body and pushes it out with an angled bat to point.
An overpitched ball outside off, Cook plays a square drive but finds the fielder.
Brilliant delivery, a little bit of away movement after landing around off, Cook tries to defend it from the crease but is beaten.

Good attempt first up. Tries to take the batsman by surprise by delivering a very full ball in the line of the stumps. Cook is up to the challenge, watches the line and length closely and digs it out at the last moment.

Right then. It's time to get underway. Clear blue skies with not even a single cloud visible at the moment. Quite a pleasant sight. Alastair Cook and debutant Ben Duckett are the English openers. Shafiul Islam to kickoff proceedings with a couple of slips and a gully. Here we go...
ENGLAND (Playing XI): Alastair Cook(c), Ben Duckett, Joe Root, Gary Ballance, Jonny Bairstow(w), Ben Stokes, Moeen Ali, Chris Woakes, Adil Rashid, Stuart Broad, Gareth Batty.
BANGLADESH (Playing XI): Tamim Iqbal, Imrul Kayes, Mominul Haque, Mahmudullah, Sabbir Rahman, Mushfiqur Rahim(w/c), Shakib Al Hasan, Mehedi Hasan, Taijul Islam, Kamrul Islam Rabbi, Shafiul Islam.

Four debutants in the match, Bangladesh have three while England have a solitary newbie. SABBIR RAHMAN, MEHEDI HASAN and KAMRUL ISLAM RABBI are the debutants for the hosts. England's debutant is BEN DUCKETT who is set to open with the skipper.
ENGLAND WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO BAT.

Hello and welcome to our coverage of the first of the two-match Test series between England and Bangladesh in Chittagong. If the ODI series was any indication, we could be in for another cracking series although the gulf between the two sides is greater in this format. Bangladesh have been very inconsistent in Tests and will need to improve drastically to challenge the formidable England side who are missing a few key players though. It shall be interesting to see if the track will be the traditional slow batting surface with spin later on or if it will be a rank turner. Toss is coming up shortly.
